content.short: Avata is an insurtech company offering customized insurance solutions for digital asset owners.
content.description: Demand for digital asset insurance is growing, but the insurance sector remains complex and fragmented. Avata’s founders observed that digital assets used in gaming could not be protected against evolving cyber risks. Their idea evolved into a solution that provides customized insurance offerings for every digital asset owner, helping individual gamers and asset holders secure their in-game belongings amid a shifting threat landscape. The aim is to make coverage accessible and relevant to diverse asset owners.
